title: General interrogation after link activation
purpose: Cover a common stateful control path by pairing link activation with an I-format interrogation ASDU using the documented station interrogation qualifier.
expected_behavior: Peer accepts STARTDT activation and then parses the interrogation ASDU as a valid station interrogation request without abnormal termination.
constraints_preserved: Both messages use IEC 60870-5-104 APDU framing with 0x68
Second message length 0x0e matches 4 APCI bytes plus 10 ASDU bytes
Uses TypeID 100 for interrogation with qualifier 20 from supplied sources
ASDU ordering follows conservative common 104 practice: TypeID, VSQ, COT, common address, IOA, qualifier
issue_safety_notes: Issue-oriented but non-colliding analogue; uses short valid I-format ASDU instead of the historical malformed long frame.
